pathway: A — PDF/HTML5 document ingestion with page OCR fallback
source_priority: S02 primary authority; S17 supplementary and cannot override S02.

scope.selection_basis: Official HTML5 outline aligned with the Week 2 V1 undergraduate service-policy scope.

requirement_mapping.FR1: pages 17–29, 35 and 49–52: membership, borrowing, renewal, fines and services
requirement_mapping.FR2: multiple selected policy sections retained with page locators
requirement_mapping.FR3_RAI1: every output record preserves source and page provenance

scope.excluded_pages: Outside the current V1 service-policy scope; deferred, not rejected.

processing.html5_role: identity, page count, outline and OCR anchors
processing.body_text_method: page OCR from frozen official-origin snapshot
processing.chunking: paragraph-aware; size=500; overlap=0; page boundaries retained

validation.repeatability_scope: deterministic post-OCR chunk preparation and JSONL serialization; OCR itself was not rerun

failure_points.condition: Native PDF extraction returns zero usable characters or zero extractable pages.
failure_points.response: Do not chunk empty text; route S02 to official HTML5 metadata acquisition plus page OCR.

failure_points.condition: A selected OCR page fails the minimum text-length or alphanumeric-ratio screen.
failure_points.response: Place affected page records in the manual review queue; keep all S02 records blocked from answering.

known_limitations: The public HTML5 configuration is not treated as a complete body-text API.
OCR may alter tables, amounts, durations or eligibility conditions.
Every S02 candidate requires rendered-page review before answering use.
The current V1 scope selects 22 of 76 pages.
